baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence كُلٌّ يَعْمَلُ عَلَىٰ شَاكِلَتِهِ ... أَهْدَىٰ سَبِيلًا distributes action by actor, then compares guidance as a way.
baseline_models.mechanism: Distributive totality assigns each agent intended action along a characteristic direction; the final comparative tests that direction by whether it conducts into a traversable path.

activation_trace.role: Encompassing totality makes the claim distributive over every actor rather than naming one class.
Intended action supplies the observable output generated by each actor's orientation.
Characteristic method and direction supplies the organizing orientation on which action proceeds.
Gentle indication toward road and truth makes guidance directional rather than a free-standing label.
An extended traversable road supplies the practical test of where a characteristic direction leads.

changed_reading.before: Each person behaves according to a private disposition.
changed_reading.after: Each agent's intended acts proceed along a characteristic direction, and the comparison asks which direction actually conducts into a traversable way.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction يَعْمَلُ عَلَىٰ شَاكِلَتِهِ places action upon a shakilah before asking about the better-guided path.
baseline_models.mechanism: Shakilah can be a binding channel, not only a temperament: action runs upon its constraint, and guidance measures whether that constraint still opens onto a viable route.

activation_trace.role: Putting something to work supplies motion operating through an imposed form.
The fetter or hobble image turns characteristic form into a constraint that channels action.
An edge or forward outlet supplies the possible exit from a constraining configuration.

changed_reading.before: Shakilah merely names an actor's temperament.
changed_reading.after: Shakilah can name the binding channel laid upon action; better guidance is the constrained course that nevertheless yields a viable outlet.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: شَاكِلَتِهِ is followed by فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ, joining patterned work to the Lord's knowing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord's reparative, completing role permits the actor's matching form to be read as a work-stamped pattern that may be cultivated over time rather than an isolated innate essence.

activation_trace.role: Matching and resemblance supplies a formed correspondence between actor and recurring work.
Being stamped or disposed toward work supplies the image of action patterned into the actor.
Repair, nurture, and completion supplies a possible formative horizon for the patterned actor.
Disclosure to the knower makes the pattern fully legible to the Lord even where its formation is hidden.

changed_reading.before: The actor's shape is simply innate and self-contained.
changed_reading.after: The actor works through a matched, work-stamped pattern that may be cultivated and completed, while the Lord alone fully reads its direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The timed establishment, night station, truthful ingress and egress, truth/falsehood transition, and healing sequence gives patterned action an itinerary. Shakilah can therefore be enacted and possibly formed through repeated stations and thresholds, not merely expressed after it is fixed.

activation_trace.role: Method and direction anchors the itinerary back in the focus actor's characteristic course.
Resolve and rising to an affair makes timed establishment a repeated directional act.
Passage into an interior supplies one threshold in the actor's practiced course.
Passage outward supplies the complementary threshold and makes orientation mobile across states.
Healing and restoration supplies a possible result of repeatedly entering the revealed course.

structural_cues: 17:78-82 moves from scheduled establishment through a night station and truthful entry/exit to truth's arrival and the same recitation's divergent effects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of stations, thresholds, and effects; I infer a formative itinerary whose repetition can shape shakilah. A live alternative is that these acts only reveal an already formed pattern.

changed_reading.before: Shakilah is a pre-existing disposition merely expressed in conduct.
changed_reading.after: Shakilah is also a practiced course: repeated orientation at times, stations, and thresholds may consolidate the very pattern from which later action proceeds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding paired conditions apply benefit and adversity, then display turning-away/distance and despair. They make shakilah observable as a response profile: a stable transformation from what reaches the actor to the direction of the actor's conduct.

activation_trace.role: Characteristic method and direction anchors the inferred response profile in the focus word.
Good condition and favor supplies the first input under which the actor's orientation is exposed.
Turning one's side supplies the first directional output, withdrawal under favor.
Distancing by the side intensifies withdrawal into a spatially legible orientation.
Impact or received effect supplies the adverse input that tests the same actor.
Hope being cut off supplies the second output and exposes the actor's brittle response pattern.

structural_cues: Two parallel إذا clauses place contrasted inputs and reactions immediately before the universalizing قُلْ كُلٌّ in 17:84.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies favor, withdrawal, adverse contact, and hope-cutoff; I infer that the paired reactions expose an underlying response profile. A live alternative is that 17:84 generalizes conduct without positing a stable input-output pattern.

changed_reading.before: Everyone acts from an invisible private temperament.
changed_reading.after: A person's shakilah becomes visible in directional reactions under changed conditions: what favor or adversity elicits is evidence of the course on which that person operates.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse places the life-principle within the Lord's affair and sharply limits granted knowledge. This revises the focus comparison into an epistemic restraint: outward works disclose a pattern, but human readers cannot exhaust the pattern's hidden source or confidently finalize who is better guided.

activation_trace.role: Full disclosure to the knower anchors the contrast between the Lord's knowledge and limited human diagnosis.
The life-bearing spirit supplies a hidden interior source not reducible to visible action.
Affair or state places that hidden source within the Lord's domain.
Littleness and paucity sets the explicit ceiling on human knowledge.

structural_cues: 17:85 answers a question about the spirit with attribution to the Lord and an إلا قليلا limitation immediately after فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a hidden life-principle, its relation to the Lord's affair, and little granted knowledge; I infer that this limits human classification of shakilah. A live alternative is that the limitation concerns only the spirit and does not qualify judgments about conduct generally.

changed_reading.before: Visible conduct lets observers classify each actor's disposition and guidance.
changed_reading.after: Visible conduct offers a trace of shakilah, but its life-source and full direction remain under the Lord's superior knowledge, so human ranking must stay provisional.

context_deltas.mechanism: Collective assistance cannot produce a match, while diversified examples still meet majority refusal. Shakilah thus expands from private temperament into a patterned capacity for production and reception that can persist even when actors combine forces and content is repeatedly varied.

activation_trace.role: Matching and resemblance anchors both attempted production of a like and patterned reception in the focus form.
Joining what is dispersed supplies collective capacity rather than isolated agency.
Likeness supplies the production test that combined actors still cannot meet.
Turning something from state to state supplies repeated variation of the presented examples.
Veiling the truth supplies the persistent reception failure despite variation.

structural_cues: 17:88 moves from total assembly and mutual support to inability; 17:89 then moves from every varied example to majority refusal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies combined production, a likeness test, varied examples, and continued veiling; I infer a persistent production/reception configuration. Alternatives remain live: the inability may concern only this text, and refusal may be a moral choice rather than a capacity pattern.

changed_reading.before: Each individual acts from a separate personal disposition.
changed_reading.after: Shakilah may also govern what a group can produce or receive: aggregation and repeated variation do not automatically alter the operative pattern.

context_deltas.mechanism: The escalating demands pre-shape what will count as acceptable evidence: spring, garden, falling sky, ornamented house, ascent, and a readable document. Shakilah becomes an acceptance gate that channels action and belief through actor-authored specifications.

activation_trace.role: The fetter image anchors the demanded criteria as a self-imposed constraint on acceptance.
Water springing from a source supplies the first material specification imposed on belief.
A claim made without certainty marks the actors' own projection inside the demanded test.
Ascent by steps supplies an escalated spectacle that their acceptance gate requires.
Ordered written characters supply the final bespoke proof they insist on reading.

structural_cues: The repeated لن نؤمن ... حتى and أو chain continually relocates the acceptance threshold across 17:90-93.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an escalating menu of conditions and an explicit uncertain claim; I infer that the conditions externalize the demanders' own constraining form. A live alternative is tactical bargaining with no stable underlying profile.

changed_reading.before: Shakilah determines only how one acts after evidence is received.
changed_reading.after: Shakilah can also pre-format evidence itself, generating the gate through which the actor will permit belief or action to pass.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human-messenger objection is answered by an environment-fit conditional: settled angelic walkers on earth would receive an angelic messenger. The matching branch of shakilah becomes a principle of embodied delivery, where the form of guidance corresponds to the recipient's mode of inhabiting the path.

activation_trace.role: Matching and correspondence anchors the proposed fit between recipient form and messenger form.
The visibly embodied human supplies the messenger form that the human recipients reject.
Walking and movement supplies the recipients' embodied way of occupying the earth.
Settled calm supplies durable inhabitation rather than a momentary angelic visit.
Messenger and message supplies the delivery role whose embodiment is matched to the recipients.

structural_cues: 17:94 states the human-messenger objection; the لو conditional in 17:95 changes the inhabitants' form and correspondingly changes the messenger's form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human refusal and an angel-on-earth counterfactual with a correspondingly angelic messenger; I infer a delivery-fit relation. A live alternative is that the conditional only rebuts one objection and does not state a general correspondence principle.

changed_reading.before: The better-guided path is independent of the embodied form of those who must receive guidance.
changed_reading.after: Guidance travels through a form fitted to its recipients' embodied mode; shakilah can name not just disposition but the correspondence that makes a path communicable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing formula specifies modalities behind رَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ: sufficiency, witnessing presence, knowledge of the interior, and sight. Divine comparison of paths is thus presented as evidentially comprehensive rather than as an ungrounded ranking.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower anchors the later witnessing and perception as modes of superior knowledge.
Carrying an affair through to sufficiency makes the divine witness adequate for the dispute.
Presence with observation supplies direct witness between the two sides.
Knowledge of an affair's interior supplies access to hidden configuration.
Ocular seeing supplies access to outward action and its visible course.

structural_cues: 17:96 closes with كَفَىٰ ... شَهِيدًا and the paired خَبِيرًا بَصِيرًا after the focus has reserved comparative knowledge to the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sufficient witness, interior acquaintance, and sight; I infer that these are complementary evidential modalities underlying 'knows best.' A live alternative is that 17:96 independently attests the message without unpacking 17:84's comparison.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's superior knowledge is a bare assertion that closes comparison.
changed_reading.after: The Lord's comparison joins witnessed presence, knowledge of hidden interiors, and sight of outward conduct, covering both shakilah and the acts that issue from it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ه د د mapping beneath أَهْدَىٰ and a downward branch of س ب ل. It remains formally anchored to the exact focus tokens and packet branches, but it must not replace the ordinary guidance/path sense; render it only as a faint material shadow in which better guidance avoids a steep, crushing descent.

activation_trace.role: A difficult steep descent supplies the branch-distant negative terrain against which better guidance can be felt.
Severe breaking and demolition supplies the possible terminal result of an unguided descent.
Letting down from high to low turns the way into a channel of descent rather than a neutral line.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply ranks actors by which one follows the better road.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material echo, it also asks which operative form channels descent without becoming a steep, breaking collapse.

strongest_changes: 17:83 turns shakilah from an invisible trait into an observable response profile under benefit and adversity.
17:78-82 makes characteristic form potentially practiced and cultivated through repeated stations, thresholds, and effects.
17:90-95 exposes both self-shaped acceptance gates and an embodied fit between recipients and the form of guidance.
17:96 grounds the Lord's comparison in witnessing, interior acquaintance, and outward sight.
summary.what_was_special: The focus branches and local sequence kept four mechanisms live at once: direction, constraint, cultivated pattern, and response profile. The ه د ي to ه د د split added a tightly contained noncollapse shadow without displacing the ordinary guidance reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether shakilah is primarily inherited form, acquired practice, or the stable relation between the two.
Whether 17:85's knowledge limit qualifies all human judgments about shakilah or only knowledge of the spirit.
Whether 17:94-95 establishes a general delivery-fit principle or only answers the local human-messenger objection.
